name: heading
title: Heading
description: A page or section title on the type scale, with its HTML level separate from its size.

when: Naming a page, a section or a group of content.

instead.when: The words are body copy, labels or captions.

guidance.rule: One level-1 heading per page; never skip levels for looks, use `size` instead.

builtIn: Renders the real h1–h6 element for `level`, so the outline stays correct.
youProvide: Levels that follow the page structure.

genui.description: A title. `level` is the document outline (1 for the page title); `size` only changes the look.
